answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 21710 Country: India Title: I would like to know the noodles under the brand name maggie is allowed to eat or not, because there was always some rumours regarding the maggie that it contains some elements which are not permissible according to islamic rules.Same is the case with butter under brand name of Amul. Question: Aslamualykum I would like to know the noodles under the brand name maggie is allowed to eat or not, because there was always some rumours regarding the maggie that it contains some elements which are not permissible according to islamic rules.Same is the case with butter under brand name of Amul. Answer ID: 21710 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 927/701/H=1431) According to the rule of ifta, this rumour and news is not enough for issuing fatwa to declare it haram. But if due to taqwa one manages to keep oneself away from it it is not prohibited as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
